scripts.build: npm run lint; npm run build-quiet
scripts.start: npm run clean; npm run build-quiet; node build/server.js
scripts.dev: npm run clean; npm run build; nodemon --watch  src/**/*  -e ts --exec 'node --inspect=0.0.0.0:9229 --require ts-node/register build/server.js'
scripts.test: bash -c 'TSX_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import tsx --test tests/*.test.mts | tee action-server-test-report.log; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}'
